metadata.name: U.S. Drought Monitor
metadata.units: percent of US area in D1 or worse
metadata.aggregation: Annual mean of weekly D1-or-worse area percentages, including the boundary week immediately before January 1.
caveats: Begins in 2000.
Drought categories have different first-observed dates.

metadata.name: MTBS mapped burned area
metadata.aggregation: Annual sum of mapped acreage for events typed as wildfire.
caveats: A mapped burned-area product with its own size, selection, and assessment criteria.
Not interchangeable with NIFC all-wildland-fire totals; never sum or merge the series.
Prescribed burns and other non-wildfire events are excluded.
The ratio to NIFC varies across the full record because MTBS maps only fires above its own size threshold; that methodological difference is separate from recent assessment lag.
MTBS assesses fires a season or more after they burn, so the newest years are still filling in and are flagged as provisional.
The current year is excluded because it is incomplete.

decades.label: 1983–1989
decades.count_caveat: 1983–84 excluded from count averages because early reporting was incomplete.

derived.top_10_sentence: All 10 of the ten biggest fire-years came since 2005
derived.count_comparison_note: 1983–84 counts are flagged and excluded from count-based comparisons.

fire_acres.sentence: NIFC reported 5,131,474 acres burned in 2025; average annual acreage rose from 2,481,611 acres in 1983–1989 to 6,929,238 acres in 2020–2025.

fire_size.sentence: The average fire grew from 41.2 acres in 1985–1989 to 107.6 acres in 2020–2025.

fire_counts.sentence: Annual fire counts averaged 72,299 in 1985–1989 and 64,375 in 2020–2025; there is no rise.

precipitation.sentence: Annual precipitation averaged 31.0 inches in 2006–2025 versus 30.1 inches across 1895–2025 while individual years ranged from 24.9 to 34.9 inches.

temperature.sentence: Annual temperature averaged 51.5 °F in 1895–1914 and 53.8 °F in 2006–2025, a change of +2.3 °F.

drought.sentence: Annual drought averaged 30.4 % in 2006–2025 versus 31.2 % across 2000–2025 while individual years ranged from 10.6 to 53.6 %.

mtbs.sentence: MTBS averaged 1,876,279 mapped acres in 1984–1993 and 6,577,623 in 2015–2024 after excluding provisional years; this is a separate mapped product, not a second NIFC total.
